_doc: Polar v2.5.0 — operator-tunable config. Wallet/chatId/decision_model resolved from env vars at runtime install (${WALLET_ADDRESS}, ${TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}, ${POLAR_DECISION_MODEL}); do NOT hardcode here. Risk gates, leverage caps, and asset cooldowns are enforced by the runtime via runtime.yaml and the producer's hardcoded constants.

leverage._v2.5_change: v3.0 ran 5/7/10 by score. v2.5 preserves these tiers but lowers MIN_SCORE 14 → 12 to fire more entries (v3.0 had 16 trades / 10 days = too few).

marginPct._note: 25% of account value per slot. Override per-deploy via POLAR_MARGIN_PCT env var.

entry._note: v3.0 hyperfeed + structural-veto gates preserved verbatim. MIN_SCORE relaxed 14 → 12. Producer constants WIN — config is informational/audit only in v2.5.

_runtime_owns._doc: These were v3.x concerns. In v2.5, the runtime owns them via runtime.yaml.guard_rails.
_runtime_owns.execution.exitOrderType: runtime.exit.order_type (FEE_OPTIMIZED_LIMIT, ensure_execution_as_taker:true — taker fallback as safety floor)
